tower.name: The Twisted Tower
tower.trait: A tower that twisted itself out of shape. It wants your definition to collapse the same way.

spaghetti.name: The Spaghetti Boss
spaghetti.trait: A knot of crossed wires and orphaned components — every messy definition ever made.

tree.name: The Branch Tree
tree.trait: It grows a new branch for every item you forget to flatten.

placeholder.name: The Blightmoth
placeholder.trait: Its dust blurs names and smears your preview.

phases.line: Slow and clumsy — it only knows how to hit.
It throws your cards around and blurs your vision.
It fights dirty: blurring names, stealing words, locking your nodes.
The last guardian. It uses every trick there is.
